description: An object type mapping each event name to its payload type, e.g. `{ login: { userId: number }; logout: void }`.
`<K extends keyof Events>` on each method lets TypeScript infer the literal event name and look up `Events[K]`.
`...args: [] | [payload: P]` turns a payload type into a parameter list, making void payloads argument-free.
`[T] extends [void]` prevents a conditional type from splitting unions.
A `() => void` returned by `on` that removes the listener it registered.
